## Install

1. Install [a-Shell](https://apps.apple.com/app/a-shell/id1473805438) from the App Store and open it once.
2. On your iPhone or iPad, download **UMDL.shortcut** below and tap **Add Shortcut**.
3. Run UMDL once to set it up. Keep the shortcut named **UMDL**.

Then share any post or video to UMDL. Full guide: [README](https://github.com/TheKfcBandit/UMDL#readme).

Something not working? [Open an issue](https://github.com/TheKfcBandit/UMDL/issues/new/choose).
